correctness.rationale: For every q>=2, k>=1, 0<=r<q, lower bound q comes from singleton factors. The proof checks all short nonwrapping, short wrapping, and long factors; every missed factor forces the three explicit boundary selections and the canonical crossing factor misses exactly those. The formula follows by exact product counting, including k=1 and r=q-1. An exhaustive separate implementation verified all 117132 candidate selections in 108 parameter cases.

originality.rationale: The relevant complete texts on morphic fixed points (arXiv:2302.13647) and smallest Fibonacci/period-doubling attractors (CPM 2026) solve different families. The known binary complete-period result is explicitly a special case and is not separately claimed new. The new statement covers all injective cycle lengths and every cutoff, with a single-factor certificate; no dominating theorem was identified in the inspected material. Full text of one relevant indexed binary-special-case record was inaccessible; possible unindexed stronger coverage is a residual risk.
residual_risks: The publicly indexed binary count is already known; novelty applies to the all-q, all-prefix classification and one-factor criterion, not the q=2,r=0 case.
